custom_b27b3a9b.name: First Interview
custom_b27b3a9b.body_template:
Dear {{name}},
I hope this email finds you well. 

Thank you for applying to the {{position}} role at Consolices. We were impressed by your background and would like to invite you for an interview.

We would like to invite you for an introductory call to discuss your skills, experiences, and interests. This call will provide an opportunity for us to get to know each other better and for you to learn more about Consolices and the exciting work we do in the IT services industry.

The call will take approximately 30 minutes and will be scheduled at a time that is convenient for you. During the call, we will discuss the open position, our company culture, and the next steps of the recruitment process.

Please book your interview slot at your earliest convenience:
{{booking_link}}

If you have any questions or need to reschedule, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{company}}

system_technical_interview.name: Technical Interview Invitation
system_technical_interview.body_template:
Dear {{name}},

Thank you for your interest in the {{position}} role at {{company}}. After reviewing your application, we would like to invite you for a technical interview.

The interview will focus on the following areas:

1. Data Structures & Algorithms
   - Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Trees, Graphs
   - Searching, Sorting, and common algorithmic patterns

2. Object-Oriented Programming
   - Core principles: Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Abstraction
   - Design patterns and SOLID principles

3. Database Concepts
   - SQL queries, joins, indexing, and normalization
   - Relational vs. non-relational databases

4. Coding Problems
   - You will be asked to solve 1-2 coding problems
   - You may use any programming language of your choice

Please book your interview slot here:
{{booking_link}}

We recommend setting aside approximately 60 minutes for the interview. Feel free to use an IDE or a whiteboard tool during the coding section.

If you have any questions or need to reschedule, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{company}}

custom_1d9d8749.name: Job Offer
custom_1d9d8749.body_template:
Subject: Offer of Employment – {{position}} at {{company}}

Dear {{name}},

Thank you for interviewing with us for the {{position}} position at {{company}}. We enjoyed getting to know you and learning about your background.

We are pleased to offer you the role of {{position}} with a monthly salary of PKR 50,000. This offer is subject to a 3-month probation period, during which your performance, learning ability, and adaptability to our workflows will be evaluated.

As this is an early-career role, we expect a strong willingness to learn, take feedback, and quickly align with our development practices and standards. Upon successful completion of the probation period, a salary review will be conducted based on your performance.

Please note that this is an onsite role. However, given that Ramadan is ongoing, you may work from home for the time being. We will inform you once we transition to the regular onsite schedule.

Please confirm your acceptance by {{acceptance_deadline}}. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out.

We look forward to having you on the team.

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{company}}
